title: Save, reload, and apply versioned context-policy artifacts
description:
## Scope

Persist policy configuration, task/schema fingerprint, candidate-pool revision and hashes, seeds, budget, order, selection provenance, and development objective. Refer to candidate IDs rather than redistributing source text; validate the referenced data when loading.

## Definition of done

Round-trip specs reproduce selected IDs; changed task, pool, policy code/version, or ordering changes identity; incompatible data is rejected and no credential is serialized.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Save, reload, and apply versioned context-policy artifacts
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given a frozen optimizer artifact and its original candidate pool
    When the artifact is reloaded for an unlabeled target
    Then the same demonstrations are selected and their provenance is available
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Versioned strict JSON artifacts bind optimizer task, pool and development/search fingerprints; store only IDs, normalized hashes, labels and configuration; reject provisional winners, mismatched references, unsupported policy versions and malformed content. All three built-in policies round-trip; apply validates generic model result. SHA-256 is an integrity checksum, not authentication. Sixteen adjacent specs plus end-to-end demo pass.
